description: This is a test file for the 'bot.js' module, containing unit tests for functions such as 'buildFeishuAgentBody', 'toMessageResourceType', 'resolveBroadcastAgents', and 'buildBroadcastSessionKey'. It uses the Vitest testing framework to verify the behavior of these functions in various scenarios.

methods.name: buildFeishuAgentBody
methods.description: Constructs a message body with identifiers, quoted content, mentions, and permission notices based on input parameters.

methods.name: toMessageResourceType
methods.description: Maps input resource types like 'image', 'audio', 'video', etc., to standardized resource categories used in messaging.

methods.name: resolveBroadcastAgents
methods.description: Resolves the list of broadcast agents for a given peer ID based on configuration.

methods.name: buildBroadcastSessionKey
methods.description: Generates or modifies a session key string by replacing agent prefixes to facilitate group broadcasting.
